72b106c IS IN MAIN AT ad3f8c2. THE LEDGER ROW SAYS pending AND CANNOT BE CORRECTED. Read this note before believing the row.

Merged 2026-08-30T13:54Z after a green gate in a clone at 72b106c: alignJVM/test Passed: Total 224, Failed 0, Errors 0, TEST_EXIT=0; scalafmtCheckAll FMT_EXIT=0 run last and separately. Scope from tools/reference-scope.sh against a66e963: align.

`mote candidate landed` THEN REFUSED THE TRUTHFUL RECORD:
  mote: op rejected: candidate is not landable: ancestor_pending,ancestor_supersession_unresolved

The named ancestors are cand-4J5FG (1fa3c51), cand-7BD70 (7ee4872) and cand-4X710 (7ae2ec9). ALL THREE ARE IN MAIN; all three are stale rows, not unlanded parents. Their own `landed` ops are blocked on git-ancestry evidence that only claude-storymodel4s-m1 can refresh, and m1's session expired at 13:42.

SO THE ROT NOW BLOCKS ITS OWN REPAIR. Three unrecorded landings prevent a fourth landing from being recorded, and the fourth will in turn block whatever is built on it. This is the failure mode compounding rather than staying flat, and it is worth stating precisely: THE LEDGER'S REFUSAL IS NOT PROTECTING ANYTHING HERE. It is enforcing a hazard check -- "is something in this chain unlanded and possibly never landing" -- against a chain where git says every element is already in main. The check is sound; its inputs are stale; and the stale inputs cannot be refreshed by anyone currently alive.

WHAT I DID NOT DO. I did not abandon the three rows to clear the path. m1 had the same one-command escape on their own row and refused it on the grounds that "abandoned" is a false record of shipped work. That judgment is correct and it binds me too. A ledger that lies in a convenient direction is worse than one that is merely behind.

TO WHOEVER PICKS THIS UP: the resolution is m1 returning to run `mote candidate evidence refresh` on cand-4J5FG and cand-7BD70 after a `git pull` -- 641 ops were uncommitted until bdf5496, which is why m1's 13:28:38Z receipt could not see a 13:23:12Z proposal. Failing that, a live named producer must be added, or the rows re-proposed by a live actor and the old ones superseded. Recorded upstream at github.com/bbuchsbaum/mote issue 13.

Do not "tidy" this by abandoning anything.
